userStories.title: Defer run:completed and return the end-phase outcome
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add independently deferred run-completion emission and a structured workflow end-phase outcome, preserving immediate behavior for existing callers.

**Motivation** — Reporter `onRunEnd`, the events log and the TUI subscribe to the same early event and get the same partial figures.

**Approach** — Relevant Design / Integration requirements, verbatim:

- `RunCompletedEvent` (`src/pipeline/event-bus/index.ts`)
  - Target: the same fields plus `workflowPassed?: boolean`, `url?: string`, `reasons?: readonly string[]`.
- `RunCompletionOptions` / `RunCompletionResult` (`src/execution/lifecycle/run-completion.ts`)
  - Target: option `deferRunCompletedEvent?: boolean`. When set, `handleRunCompletion` emits no `run:completed`; its result carries `emitRunCompleted: (final: RunCompleteFinal) => void`, which emits it with the story counts and `fallback` that phase 5 computed and the `errorCostUsd` from the phase-3 cost snapshot (`snapshotCostsAndBackfill`, passed into phase 5), and the `durationMs`, `totalCost`, `workflowPassed`, `url` and `reasons` of `final`. `emitRunCompletedAndSaveMetrics` returns the payload it would have emitted (today it receives `errorCostField`, computes the fallback aggregate inline and returns only `finalCounts`), and `emitRunCompleted` overlays `final` on it. When unset, behaviour is unchanged and the result has no `emitRunCompleted`. `deferRunCompletedEvent` and the existing `deferRunCompleteLog` are independent: either may be set without the other, and `runCompletionPhase` sets both. When phase 7.5 (MCP adoption summary) or phase 8 (final status) rejects and the event is deferred, `handleRunCompletion` emits it in the same `catch` that already writes the held-back `run.complete` line, with the figures it holds and `workflowPassed` `false` when `isWorkflowMode(config)` (`true` in pipeline mode), and awaits `pipelineEventBus.drain()` before the error propagates. Phase 6 (stale-artifact purge) is fail-open and never reaches that `catch`.
- `RunCompleteFinal` (same file)
  - Target: adds `url?: string` and `reasons?: readonly string[]`. Once the end phase is closed, `reasons` is always set (`[]` on a pass) and `url` only when the end phase produced one.
- `runEndPhase` (`src/execution/end-phase.ts`)
  - Target: `runEndPhase(options, deps): Promise<EndPhaseOutcome | undefined>`, with `EndPhaseOutcome { passed: boolean; url?: string; reasons: readonly string[] }` exported from the same file. Pipeline mode still returns `undefined`.

US-001 story requirements, verbatim: Add the `deferRunCompletedEvent` option and the `emitRunCompleted` result member to `handleRunCompletion`, independent of `deferRunCompleteLog`; extend `RunCompletedEvent` and `RunCompleteFinal` with `workflowPassed`, `url` and `reasons`; emit the deferred event (and drain) in the existing phase 7.5/8 `catch`. Change `runEndPhase` to return `EndPhaseOutcome`, with the reasons `feature workflow failed: <message>` and `run aborted`. Update the stale header comment on `emitRunCompletedAndSaveMetrics`. Nothing calls `emitRunCompleted` yet; US-002 wires it.

Implementation boundaries: RunCompleteFinal already has workflowPassed; retain it. The callback is exposed to the caller only on successful deferred completion; on phase-7.5/8 rejection emit within handleRunCompletion before rethrowing. Keep metric saving best-effort even when event emission is deferred. runWorkflowEnd maps a null result to passed true, reasons [], and no URL; passes successful result metadata through; maps WORKFLOW_ABORTED or pre-aborted execution to passed false with ['run aborted']; maps any other exception to passed false with ['feature workflow failed: <message>']. Keep pipeline finish fail-open. Adapt runEndPhaseReported to read the outcome's passed so this story compiles, but leave URL/reasons threading to US-002. Modify end-phase.test.ts's boolean assertions to outcome assertions and retain existing logging expectations. Create test/unit/execution/lifecycle/run-completed-deferred.test.ts.

**Scope** — In: event payload extension, lifecycle deferral/late-phase fallback, end-phase outcome and its immediate consumer's type adaptation. Out: runner/gate wiring and on-complete hook projection (US-002); workflow bus producers (US-003); new workflow hooks (US-004). Renaming test titles that describe the old timing is excluded.

**Interface** — Target declarations from the spec: `deferRunCompletedEvent?: boolean`; `emitRunCompleted: (final: RunCompleteFinal) => void`; `workflowPassed?: boolean`, `url?: string`, `reasons?: readonly string[]`; `runEndPhase(options, deps): Promise<EndPhaseOutcome | undefined>`; `EndPhaseOutcome { passed: boolean; url?: string; reasons: readonly string[] }`. The result member is absent unless deferral was requested.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] handleRunCompletion called with deferRunCompletedEvent: true emits no run:completed on pipelineEventBus before it resolves, and its result's emitRunCompleted is a function.
[unit] (regression anchor) handleRunCompletion called without deferRunCompletedEvent emits exactly one run:completed before it resolves, and its result has no emitRunCompleted.
[unit] handleRunCompletion called with deferRunCompletedEvent: true and deferRunCompleteLog unset writes the run.complete log line before it resolves and emits no run:completed.

[unit] Calling the deferred result's emitRunCompleted with a RunCompleteFinal of durationMs 9000, totalCost 4.94, workflowPassed true, url 'https://github.com/o/r/pull/295' and reasons [] emits exactly one run:completed whose durationMs is 9000, totalCost is 4.94, workflowPassed is true, url is that URL, and whose passedStories, failedStories, skippedStories and pausedStories equal countStories of the run's PRD.
[unit] Calling emitRunCompleted with workflowPassed false and reasons ['final gates red: lint'] emits a run:completed whose workflowPassed is false and whose reasons equal ['final gates red: lint'].

[unit] handleRunCompletion called with deferRunCompletedEvent: true, whose _runCompletionDeps.summarizeMcpAdoptionPhase rejects with Error('mcp down'), rejects with 'mcp down' and has emitted exactly one run:completed before rejecting.

[unit] handleRunCompletion called with deferRunCompletedEvent: true in workflow mode, whose statusWriter.update rejects with Error('status down'), rejects with 'status down' and has emitted exactly one run:completed, with workflowPassed false, before rejecting.

[unit] runEndPhase in workflow mode, with runWorkflowFeature resolving { passed: true, outcome: 'ready', url: 'https://github.com/o/r/pull/295', reasons: [] }, returns { passed: true, url: 'https://github.com/o/r/pull/295', reasons: [] }.
[unit] runEndPhase in workflow mode, with runWorkflowFeature resolving null, returns passed true, reasons [] and no url.
[unit] runEndPhase in workflow mode, with runWorkflowFeature rejecting with Error('boom'), returns passed false and reasons ['feature workflow failed: boom'].
[unit] runEndPhase in workflow mode, with runWorkflowFeature rejecting with a NaxError of code WORKFLOW_ABORTED, returns passed false and reasons ['run aborted'].
[unit] runEndPhase in workflow mode with exitReason 'aborted' returns passed false and reasons ['run aborted'], and does not call runWorkflowFeature.
[unit] When deferred handleRunCompletion encounters a phase-7.5 or phase-8 rejection in workflow mode, its emitted run:completed has workflowPassed false.
[unit] When deferred handleRunCompletion encounters a phase-7.5 or phase-8 rejection in pipeline mode, its emitted run:completed has workflowPassed true.

[unit] When deferred handleRunCompletion emits run:completed from its phase-7.5/8 catch and a subscriber returns an unsettled promise that settles within the bus deadline, the original rejection is observable only after that subscriber settles.

routing.reasoning: Cross-module lifecycle API change with independent deferral controls, captured cost/count payloads and asynchronous rejection-path delivery; well-specified integration suits the balanced implementation profile.

`emitRunCompletedAndSaveMetrics` skips the emit when deferred, still saves the metrics, and returns the payload; its comment no longer says the event fires before the feature workflow.

US-001's `runEndPhase` acceptance tests may be added to this file.

userStories.title: Emit on-complete after the end phase with whole-run figures
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Wire deferred run completion to the existing exactly-once gate after finish or the feature workflow, delivering whole-run totals and workflow verdict metadata to on-complete.

**Motivation** — A notification hook therefore reports "complete" about 25 minutes early, with a stories-only cost, and never reports the PR or a failed workflow.

**Approach** — Relevant Design / Integration requirements, verbatim:

- `runEndPhaseReported` / `EndPhaseReport` (`src/execution/workflow-end-report.ts`): passes `url` and `reasons` from the `EndPhaseOutcome` into the `RunCompleteFinal` handed to `gate.log`. `EndPhaseReport.workflowPassed` keeps its meaning.
- `finishRun` (`src/execution/runner-completion.ts`): the gate's write callback calls both `completionResult.logRunComplete?.(final)` and `completionResult.emitRunCompleted?.(final)`, so the event inherits the gate's exactly-once guarantee on the success path and the `finally` path. `runCompletionPhase` passes `deferRunCompletedEvent: true` and awaits `pipelineEventBus.drain()` in a `finally` around `finishRun`, so hook delivery is awaited on the rejection path too. `drain()` is bounded by the bus's existing 5-second settle deadline (`DRAIN_SETTLE_DEADLINE_MS`); a hook still running past it is not awaited. The `finally` fallback of `finishRun` sets no `reasons` and no `url`, so `on-complete` then carries neither `NAX_REASON` nor `NAX_RESULT_URL`. `runner-completion.ts` is 585 lines against the 600-line limit: its net growth stays at or under 10 lines, and any further logic goes in `workflow-end-report.ts` or `end-phase.ts`. `runCompletionPhase` is at its complexity baseline (34, `scripts/baselines/complexity-baseline.json`), so the new calls add no branches to it; the route for this constraint is the existing `bun run check:complexity` gate (part of `bun run lint`), not an AC.
- `wireHooks`: the `run:completed` mapping sends status `failed` when `ev.workflowPassed === false`, otherwise `complete`; `reason` is `ev.reasons` joined with `"; "` when non-empty; `url` is `ev.url`.

Additional applicable Design prose, verbatim:
The events writer (`src/pipeline/subscribers/events-writer.ts`), the reporters subscriber and the TUI (`src/tui/hooks/usePipelineBusEvents.ts`) subscribe to `run:completed` unchanged; they observe it after the end phase, with the whole-run figures, and need no code change. The TUI disarms its retry key on `run:completed`, so the key now stays armed through the end phase, where a retry is a silent no-op (accepted; see Out of Scope). The events log's `on-complete` line, which an external watchdog reads as the graceful-exit signal (`events-writer.ts` header), therefore lands after the feature workflow instead of before it; it is still written before the process exits, so the graceful-exit meaning holds. A watchdog that bounds the gap between the last story and that line must allow for the feature workflow's duration (accepted).

Tests that assert a hook command's environment await `pipelineEventBus.drain()` after emitting, since hook delivery is asynchronous.

US-002 story requirements, verbatim: In `runCompletionPhase`, pass `deferRunCompletedEvent: true`, give the `run.complete` gate in `finishRun` a write callback that calls both `logRunComplete` and `emitRunCompleted`, thread `url` and `reasons` from `EndPhaseOutcome` into `RunCompleteFinal` in `runEndPhaseReported`, and drain the bus in a `finally` around `finishRun`. Map `workflowPassed`, `reasons` and `url` onto the `on-complete` hook in `wireHooks`. Correct the comments on `runEndPhaseReported`, `closeWorkflowRun`, `src/metrics/run-duration.ts` and `run-cleanup.ts` that place `run:completed` before the end phase. In `docs/guides/hooks.md`, state that `on-complete` fires after the end phase with whole-run cost and document the `failed` status, `NAX_REASON` and `NAX_RESULT_URL` on it.

Preserve the existing gate's success/finally behavior, use the end-closure clock and aggregator snapshot for durationMs/totalCost, and retain phase-5 counts/fallback/errorCostUsd from US-001. A closed end phase always sets reasons (including [] in pipeline mode) and only supplies a URL it actually produced. An already-finished workflow carries its prior URL and current verdict. An ordinary workflow throw is converted by runEndPhase into a failed outcome with 'feature workflow failed: <message>'; abort becomes 'run aborted'. A rejecting finishRun emits once through the finally fallback and propagates its error after draining; do not fabricate metadata for that fallback. A rejection after finishRun preserves the already-emitted verdict and propagates without a second event. Modify whole-object RunCompleteFinal expectations in both runner-completion-workflow-duration.test.ts and runner-completion-pipeline-duration.test.ts to include reasons: []. Create test/unit/execution/run-completed-after-end-phase.test.ts and test/unit/pipeline/subscribers/hooks-on-complete.test.ts.

**Scope** — In: runner/gate wiring, end-outcome metadata threading, final hook projection, duration-test updates and timing documentation. Out: deferred lifecycle API construction (US-001), workflow event production (US-003), and new workflow hook registration/mappings (US-004). No pipeline PR URL threading, reporter API additions, TUI/watchdog changes, second event on post-finish failure, duplicate cleanup reporter repair, or drain-deadline increase.

**Interface** — Existing interfaces used unchanged: `createRunCompleteGate(write)` / `RunCompleteGate`; `runEndPhase(options, deps): Promise<EndPhaseOutcome | undefined>` from US-001. New callback consumed: `emitRunCompleted: (final: RunCompleteFinal) => void`; final metadata: `url?: string` and `reasons?: readonly string[]`. `EndPhaseReport.workflowPassed` remains undefined in pipeline mode; `RunCompleteFinal.workflowPassed` is true there.

userStories.title: Emit feature-workflow start, step and publish bus events
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add typed workflow bus events at the existing feature-run and real sink boundaries without wiring hooks yet.

**Motivation** — The feature workflow then ran for 24 minutes — repo gates, branch review, publish, an 8-minute CI wait, an advisor approval — and marked PR #295 ready at 08:58:34 with a total of $4.94.

**Approach** — Relevant Design / Integration requirements, verbatim:

- `PipelineEvent` union (same file)
  - Target: adds `WorkflowStartedEvent { type: "workflow:started"; step: string }`, `WorkflowStepEvent { type: "workflow:step"; step: string }`, `WorkflowPublishedEvent { type: "workflow:published"; outcome: string; ci?: string; url?: string; passed: boolean; reasons: readonly string[] }`. `step`, `outcome` and `ci` are typed `string` so the bus takes no dependency on `@/workflow`.
- `runWorkflowFeature` / `runInContext` (`src/workflow/feature.ts`): emits `workflow:started` with the record's starting step immediately before it calls `runFeatureMachine`, and `workflow:published` from the final record after `runFeatureMachine` returns, with `outcome` defaulting to `"local-only"` and `passed` to `false` when the record has none (the defaults `resultOf` uses). The already-finished, dry-run and aborted early returns emit neither.
- `buildFeatureEnv`'s sink (`src/workflow/feature-env.ts`): `sink.step(step, record)` emits `workflow:step` for every step except `"done"`, alongside the existing status-block update. The starting step therefore sends both `on-workflow-start` and `on-workflow-step`, and a step the cost limit then skips (`costStop` runs after `sink.step`) still sends `on-workflow-step`.

Read-only integration declarations from the spec:
- `runFeatureMachine(env: FeatureEnv): Promise<WorkflowFeatureRecord>` — `src/workflow/feature-machine.ts`; calls `env.sink.step(step, rec)` before each step and `env.sink.step("done", rec)` at the end. `publishStep` always returns `step: "done"`.
- `FeatureStep` = `"repo-gates" | "branch-review" | "branch-fix" | "branch-rereview" | "adjudicate" | "final-gates" | "gate-repair" | "publish" | "done"`; `FeatureOutcome` = `"ready" | "draft" | "local-only" | "pushed"`; `FeatureCiState` = `"green" | "failed" | "pending" | "skipped" | "conflicting" | "no-checks" | "unavailable"` — `src/workflow/types.ts`.

US-003 story requirements, verbatim: Add `WorkflowStartedEvent`, `WorkflowStepEvent` and `WorkflowPublishedEvent` to `PipelineEvent`. Emit `workflow:started` and `workflow:published` from `runInContext` in `src/workflow/feature.ts`, and `workflow:step` from the sink `buildFeatureEnv` returns, for every step but `done`. No hook is wired yet; US-004 does that.

Use the singleton pipelineEventBus; preserve early returns and context disposal. Emit started only once preparation succeeded, using the resumed record's actual starting step (not a hardcoded repo-gates). Emit published only after successful machine return, carrying final record outcome/ci/url/passed/reasons and the stated defaults, including local-only with no URL. A machine throw leaves start and any already-emitted step events unmatched; it emits no published event and propagates to runEndPhase, which US-001 converts to the failed completion verdict. A prior record truly finished at current HEAD emits none of the three workflow events; keep the existing current-verdict/prior-URL return. Do not confuse a transient draft that resumes publishing with the already-finished skip. Keep the sink's status update, done suppression and cost-stop order; no machine API change is required. Create test/unit/workflow/feature-events.test.ts and extend feature-env.test.ts for the real sink assertions.

**Scope** — In: three event interfaces/union members, feature start/publish production, real-sink step production and associated unit behavior. Out: completion deferral (US-001), runner final emission (US-002), hook definitions/environment/mappings/docs (US-004). No events-log/TUI support, per-poll CI events, step-finished events or story-loop hooks.

**Interface** — Verbatim target shapes: `WorkflowStartedEvent { type: "workflow:started"; step: string }`, `WorkflowStepEvent { type: "workflow:step"; step: string }`, `WorkflowPublishedEvent { type: "workflow:published"; outcome: string; ci?: string; url?: string; passed: boolean; reasons: readonly string[] }`; existing `runFeatureMachine(env: FeatureEnv): Promise<WorkflowFeatureRecord>` stays unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] runWorkflowFeature, with _featureRunDeps.buildFeatureContext and _featureRunDeps.runFeatureMachine stubbed and no prior record, emits exactly one workflow:started on pipelineEventBus with step 'repo-gates', before runFeatureMachine is called.
[unit] runWorkflowFeature, with _featureRunDeps.buildFeatureContext stubbed to reject, rejects and emits no workflow:started.

[unit] runWorkflowFeature, with runFeatureMachine stubbed to resolve a record of outcome 'ready', ci 'green', url 'https://github.com/o/r/pull/295', passed true and reasons [], emits exactly one workflow:published with those five values, after runFeatureMachine resolved.

[unit] runWorkflowFeature, with runFeatureMachine stubbed to resolve a record with no outcome and no passed, emits a workflow:published with outcome 'local-only' and passed false.
[unit] runWorkflowFeature, with runFeatureMachine stubbed to reject, rejects and emits no workflow:published.
[unit] runWorkflowFeature when the prior record is finished at the current HEAD (the already-finished path) emits no workflow:started and no workflow:published.
[unit] runWorkflowFeature with runtime.dryRun true returns null and emits no workflow:* event.
[unit] The sink returned by buildFeatureEnv, called as step('branch-review', record), emits exactly one workflow:step with step 'branch-review'.
[unit] The sink returned by buildFeatureEnv, called as step('done', record), emits no workflow:step.
[unit] When runWorkflowFeature returns early because abortSignal is already aborted, it emits no workflow:started, workflow:step or workflow:published event.

[unit] When runFeatureMachine rejects with an ordinary error after a workflow:started emission, runWorkflowFeature leaves that started event and any already-emitted workflow:step events unmatched and emits no workflow:published.
[unit] When runFeatureMachine rejects with NaxError code WORKFLOW_ABORTED, runWorkflowFeature emits no workflow:published and propagates the rejection.
[unit] When runWorkflowFeature takes its already-finished-at-current-HEAD early return, it emits no workflow:step event.

[unit] Given buildFeatureEnv with ctx.stories containing one StorySummary with id 'US-001', state 'complete' and rounds 2, when its sink.step('publish', record) receives a record with outcome 'draft' and url 'u', statusWriter.setWorkflowStatus receives { step: 'publish', stories: { 'US-001': { state: 'complete', round: 2 } }, outcome: 'draft', url: 'u' }, preserving the existing status-block update alongside the new event.

routing.reasoning: Three existing modules gain additive typed event production at explicit boundaries; no new orchestration abstraction or security control changes are required.

`runInContext` emits `workflow:started` and `workflow:published`.

userStories.title: Expose workflow start, step and publish hooks
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Expose the feature-workflow bus events as configurable hooks with sanitized step/CI environment variables and document their lifecycle.

**Motivation** — No hook fired for any of it.

**Approach** — Relevant Design / Integration requirements, verbatim:

- `HookEvent` / `HOOK_EVENTS` (`src/hooks/types.ts`): adds `"on-workflow-start"`, `"on-workflow-step"`, `"on-workflow-publish"`. `HookContext` adds `step?: string` and `ci?: string`; `buildEnv` maps them to `NAX_STEP` and `NAX_CI`.
- `wireHooks`: the `run:completed` mapping sends status `failed` when `ev.workflowPassed === false`, otherwise `complete`; `reason` is `ev.reasons` joined with `"; "` when non-empty; `url` is `ev.url`. New mappings: `workflow:started` to `on-workflow-start` (status `running`, `step`), `workflow:step` to `on-workflow-step` (`step`), `workflow:published` to `on-workflow-publish` (status = outcome, `ci`, `url`, `reason` = reasons joined with `"; "`).

The run:completed portion is already implemented by US-002; preserve it rather than reimplementing it. Read-only integration declarations, verbatim:
- `wireHooks(bus: PipelineEventBus, hooks: LoadedHooksConfig, workdir: string, feature: string): UnsubscribeFn` — `src/pipeline/subscribers/hooks.ts`; each subscription calls `fireHook` through a local `safe(name, fn)` that logs a failure at warn and never rethrows.
- `hookCtx(feature: string, opts?: Partial<Omit<HookContext, "event" | "feature">>): HookContext` — `src/execution/story-context`.
- `fireHook(config, event, ctx, workdir)` — `src/hooks/runner.ts`; `buildEnv(ctx)` maps context fields to `NAX_*` variables, `ctx.url` to `NAX_RESULT_URL`.

Tests that assert a hook command's environment await `pipelineEventBus.drain()` after emitting, since hook delivery is asynchronous.

US-004 story requirements, verbatim: Add `on-workflow-start`, `on-workflow-step` and `on-workflow-publish` to `HOOK_EVENTS`, `step` and `ci` to `HookContext`, and `NAX_STEP` / `NAX_CI` to `buildEnv`; map the three `workflow:*` bus events in `wireHooks`. Document the three hooks and the two variables in `docs/guides/hooks.md`, including the event-order diagram, add them to the hook table in `docs/architecture/subsystems.md` and the Hooks list in `packages/nax/README.md`. US-002 must land first because both stories edit `wireHooks` and `docs/guides/hooks.md`.

Hook timing contract from the spec:
| Hook | When | `NAX_STATUS` | Other variables |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `on-all-stories-complete` | Unchanged: every story passed, before the regression gate | `passed` | `NAX_COST` (stories) |
| `on-workflow-start` | Feature workflow begins (workflow mode) | `running` | `NAX_STEP` = starting step |
| `on-workflow-step` | Each feature-workflow step begins, including the starting step and a step the cost limit then skips | — | `NAX_STEP` |
| `on-workflow-publish` | Publish finished | outcome: `ready`, `draft`, `pushed`, `local-only` | `NAX_CI`, `NAX_RESULT_URL` (when a URL exists), `NAX_REASON` |
| `on-complete` | End phase done, both modes | `complete`, or `failed` when the feature workflow did not pass | `NAX_COST` (whole run), `NAX_REASON`, `NAX_RESULT_URL` |

Keep empty reasons absent from NAX_REASON, omit NAX_RESULT_URL without a URL (including no-forge/local-only publish), and do not set a status on the step hook. New environment fields must use existing escapeEnvValue projection and buildAllowedEnv flow, retaining trust checks, argv execution, global/project behavior, timeout controls and JSON stdin; no security policy changes are requested. Nonzero exit/timeout remains warn-and-resolve with the event name in 'Global hook <event> failed' / 'Project hook <event> failed'. Reuse local safe for subscribers and collect their unsubscribe functions. Preserve existing hook definitions when new workflow definitions coexist in hooks.json. In producer-seam fixtures, return a complete WorkflowFeatureRecord by extending the input record and overriding the stated fields; supply required event fields even when an AC names only the fields under assertion. runFeatureMachine takes exactly one FeatureEnv argument: configure ctx.record.step as 'publish' before buildFeatureEnv constructs env, keep env.sink unchanged, and replace only env.steps.publish for the step seam. The added environment fields use the existing escaping path; do not edit trust, permission or command-validation policy. Add test/unit/pipeline/subscribers/hooks-workflow.test.ts; prove real producer-to-hook seams through runWorkflowFeature with only context/machine stubbed and through runFeatureMachine with buildFeatureEnv's sink unchanged and only steps.publish stubbed. Show workflow-start -> first workflow-step -> further steps -> publish -> on-complete in workflow mode, finish -> on-complete in pipeline mode, and preserve cleanup post-run actions after on-complete in the guide. No event is invented for done, already-finished, dry-run or aborted early returns.

**Scope** — In: workflow hook registration, context/env projection, bus-to-hook wiring, end-to-end seam tests and the guide/architecture/README updates. Out: event production (US-003) and final-completion timing/gate wiring (US-001/US-002). No story-loop hooks, events-log/TUI additions, per-poll CI, step-finished/duration events, user hook config/script changes, billed live run or longer drain deadline.

**Interface** — Existing `wireHooks(bus: PipelineEventBus, hooks: LoadedHooksConfig, workdir: string, feature: string): UnsubscribeFn` and `hookCtx(feature: string, opts?: Partial<Omit<HookContext, "event" | "feature">>): HookContext` are unchanged. Context additions: `step?: string` and `ci?: string`. Event shapes consumed from US-003: `WorkflowStartedEvent { type: "workflow:started"; step: string }`, `WorkflowStepEvent { type: "workflow:step"; step: string }`, `WorkflowPublishedEvent { type: "workflow:published"; outcome: string; ci?: string; url?: string; passed: boolean; reasons: readonly string[] }`.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] HOOK_EVENTS contains 'on-workflow-start', 'on-workflow-step' and 'on-workflow-publish', and a hooks.json declaring on-workflow-step loaded with loadHooksConfig keeps that hook definition.
[unit] fireHook for 'on-workflow-step' with a context whose step is 'publish' runs the configured command with NAX_EVENT 'on-workflow-step' and NAX_STEP 'publish'.
[unit] fireHook for 'on-workflow-publish' with a context whose ci is 'pending' runs the configured command with NAX_CI 'pending'.

[unit] With wireHooks subscribed to a PipelineEventBus and an on-workflow-start hook whose command records its environment, emitting workflow:started with step 'branch-fix' and draining runs the command with NAX_STATUS 'running' and NAX_STEP 'branch-fix'.
[unit] With the same wiring and an on-workflow-step hook, emitting workflow:step with step 'final-gates' and draining runs the command with NAX_STEP 'final-gates'.

[unit] With the same wiring and an on-workflow-publish hook, emitting workflow:published with outcome 'ready', ci 'green', url 'https://github.com/o/r/pull/295', passed true and reasons [] and draining runs the command with NAX_STATUS 'ready', NAX_CI 'green', NAX_RESULT_URL 'https://github.com/o/r/pull/295' and no NAX_REASON.

[unit] With the same wiring, emitting workflow:published with outcome 'draft', no url and reasons ['CI failed', 'approval withheld'] and draining runs the on-workflow-publish command with NAX_STATUS 'draft', NAX_REASON 'CI failed; approval withheld' and no NAX_RESULT_URL.

[unit] With the same wiring and an on-workflow-step hook whose command exits non-zero, emitting workflow:step and draining does not throw, and fireHook logs one warn whose message names on-workflow-step.

[integration] With wireHooks subscribed to pipelineEventBus and on-workflow-start and on-workflow-publish hooks whose commands record their environment, calling runWorkflowFeature with buildFeatureContext and runFeatureMachine stubbed (the machine resolving outcome 'ready' with url 'https://github.com/o/r/pull/295') and draining runs the on-workflow-start command with NAX_STEP 'repo-gates' and the on-workflow-publish command with NAX_RESULT_URL 'https://github.com/o/r/pull/295'; the test asserts each command's recorded environment and makes no assertion about the order in which the two commands finish.

[integration] With wireHooks subscribed to pipelineEventBus and an on-workflow-step hook whose command records its environment, calling runFeatureMachine(env) with the env returned by buildFeatureEnv (its sink unchanged, its steps.publish replaced by a stub resolving outcome 'ready') with env.record.step set to 'publish', then draining, runs the on-workflow-step command exactly once, with NAX_STEP 'publish'.

[unit] With wireHooks subscribed and an on-workflow-publish hook configured, emitting workflow:published for outcome 'local-only' without a URL and draining runs the hook with NAX_STATUS 'local-only' and no NAX_RESULT_URL.

[unit] When an on-workflow-step hook command times out, fireHook resolves and logs a warn named 'Global hook on-workflow-step failed' or 'Project hook on-workflow-step failed' for the configured hook scope without propagating the timeout to the emitter.

[unit] When loadHooksConfig loads a project hooks.json containing both an existing on-start definition and a new on-workflow-step definition, its hooks map retains both definitions unchanged, preserving existing hook configuration alongside the new event.

US-001 producer seam: packages/nax/src/pipeline/event-bus/index.ts:87 defines RunCompletedEvent, with counts, duration, optional totalCost, errorCostUsd and fallback. packages/nax/src/execution/lifecycle/run-completion.ts:61 defines RunCompletionOptions; :115 defines RunCompleteFinal, whose workflowPassed already exists; :129 defines RunCompletionResult. Add only the target fields, not a duplicate workflowPassed on RunCompleteFinal. handleRunCompletion sequences regression, review, phase-3 cost snapshot, teardown, phase-5 event/metrics, fail-open purge, logging, MCP summary and final status (same file :159 onward). Its existing catch surrounds only phase 7.5 and phase 8 (:232 onward); preserve that boundary. packages/nax/src/execution/lifecycle/run-completion-phases.ts:121 snapshots the authoritative total and error-cost component; :175 emits the current early run event and saves metrics; :192 derives fallback once from backfilled story metrics. Return both finalCounts and the captured event payload, suppress only event emission when deferred, and keep metric persistence best-effort. The deferred callback must preserve captured counts, fallback and phase-3 errorCostUsd while overlaying final duration, total cost and workflow fields. Normal closure produces reasons [] even in pipeline mode; the finishRun fallback deliberately has no reasons or URL and carries its existing figures-so-far semantics. runCompletionPhase must pass both defer flags and await drain in a finally around finishRun, not only on success. Do this without adding branches: runner-completion.ts is 585 lines, its net growth must not exceed 10 lines, and runCompletionPhase has complexity baseline 34. Keep this deadline; delivery beyond it is explicitly not guaranteed to be awaited. outOfScope: A PR URL on `on-complete` in pipeline mode: the `finish` phase result is not threaded, so pipeline-mode `on-complete` carries no `NAX_RESULT_URL`.
Per-poll CI-wait events: CI state is reported only once, on `on-workflow-publish`.
A step-finished event or per-step durations: `on-workflow-step` fires when a step begins.
Recording `workflow:*` events in the events log (`~/.nax/events`) or showing them in the TUI.
New fields on the reporter plugin API: `onRunEnd` gets the later timing and whole-run cost but no workflow outcome or URL.
`errorCostUsd` on the moved `run:completed`: it stays the figure computed in `handleRunCompletion` phase 5.

The duplicate `onRunEnd` that `cleanupRun` sends when the completion phase rejects after `run:completed` was emitted (the `finishRun` and `handleRunCompletion` rejection paths, where `runCompleted` stays false): pre-existing behaviour on the same paths, not changed here.
A second `run:completed` or a changed verdict when a step of `runCompletionPhase` after `finishRun` rejects: the event already went out with the end phase's verdict.

Renaming test titles that describe the old timing (for example the `describe` in `test/unit/execution/lifecycle-completion.test.ts`); their assertions call `handleRunCompletion` without the new option and stay true.
The TUI retry key staying armed while the end phase runs: pressing `r` then is a silent no-op, as it was not before; the TUI is not changed.
Raising the bus's 5-second drain deadline: a hook command running longer than it is not awaited at run end.
Telling apart a step the cost limit skips: `on-workflow-step` fires for it like any other step.
Changing an external watchdog that reads the events log's `on-complete` line: that line now lands after the feature workflow.
Workflow-mode story-loop events (implementer, story review, fix rounds) as hooks.
The meaning of `on-all-stories-complete` and the stories-only cost on `on-story-complete`.
Updating a user's own `~/.nax/hooks.json` or hook scripts to subscribe to the new events: a manual step.
A billed live run that observes the new hooks end to end: a maintainer step after merge.
